publish.label: Tuesday, November 17, 2026
publish.why: Weekend results from Pizza RYC (New Haven) and Freehold are official and final. Kiefer Meinhardt results have not posted (Mon 8:52 AM ET); Wednesday gives them another day. The November NAC starts Fri. Nov. 20, so the preview needs to go out by Thursday.

desk_summary: Issue No. 7, target Tue. Nov. 17 (alt Wed. Nov. 18). Monday full pass done 9:00 AM ET; v1.

Lead (proposed): Penny Young's bronze in Y12 Women at Pizza RYC (3rd of 52), with Penny and Amina Gore's other top-16 finishes and Nico Ng's 5th of 30 at Freehold. All from official USA Fencing results (final). Kiefer Meinhardt (Stella Kuo, Mila Siu) not posted yet.
Club Results: 5 strong rows (4 Pizza RYC, 1 Freehold). No ratings earned found for Elite FC in the posted results: see the question on Ratings.

Boards: Cobra Challenge (Secaucus, Nov. 27–29; 26 entries / 16 fencers, unchanged); NJFA Dec. 1 (Owen Li); On the Road = November NAC with new Athreya Aravind Div I Men entry Mon. Nov. 23. Deadlines rebuilt: Z1 Nov. 23, Fairfax and NJFA Nov. 30, JO late reg Jan. 7, NJ HS Jan. 8.

Page 2: your VR comic (vetted), proposed For the Parents on Cobra next door, NAC preview short, FIE World Cup weekend short, By the Book 'Three Calls, Two Minutes'. Most new pieces need your Vet. Fill is light until you vet them.
